positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
- Cloud Collection service for Groove Music and Movies&TV. This is the service used to synchronise user data (collection, OneDrive music tracks, playlists, last position in videos) accross different devices. 
- Movies Anywhere synchronisation service. Movies Anywhere is a service available in the US which aims at gathering all digital movie purchases and make them available on different retailers (Apple iTunes, Google Play Store, Amazon Video, Microsoft Movies&TV). When you buy one movie on one of the retailer, it becomes consumable on the other retailers. The service I worked on is the service which does the synchronisation of purchases coming from Movies Anywhere to the Microsoft licensing services and the other way around.

positions.title: Intern Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
The team was working on a service responsible of synchronizing user data for Groove Music (collection, playlists) and Movies&TV (last position).

Worked on tools to securely access (with shared access signatures) production Azure Storage accounts containing user data for Groove Music and Movies&TV. 

Helped designing the migration of the service from a single datacenter to multiple ones.

positions.title: Président
positions.description:
Organisation de la Journée des Partenaires pour l'Ensimag (Ecole Nationale Supérieure d'Informatique de de Mathématiques Appliquées) à Grenoble.
Pendant cette journée, 47 entreprises sont conviées dans les locaux de l'école pour rencontrer les étudiants et leurs professeurs.
L'événement a été préparé en étroite collaboration avec les représentants des entreprises, les responsables de l'école et des 10 membres de l'association.

projects.title: OGG/Vorbis Decoder in C
projects.description: Implementation of the whole decoder of the Vorbis stream included in OGG packets. This project was composed of computing in C language as well as mathematical modeling.
